statutory_dues.text:
<span>
<span>(a) The company has generally been regular in depositing with appropriate authorities undisputed statutory dues including Goods and Services Tax, provident fund, employees’ state insurance, income-tax, sales-tax, service tax, duty of custom, duty of excise, value added tax, cess and any other statutory dues applicable to it. However, there were minor delays in depositing Goods and Service tax, PT (in Gujarat, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh and Assam region). Further, the company has defaulted in depositing undisputed professional tax of Gujarat, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh and Assam amounting to Rs:5,27,293 to the appropriate authorities. According to the information and explanations given to us, no undisputed amounts payable in respect of goods and services tax, provident fund, employees’ state insurance, income-tax, sales-tax, service tax, duty of custom, duty of excise, value added tax, cess and other statutory dues were outstanding, at the year end, for a period of more than six mo

business_summary.text: Banka BioLoo operates as an integrated water and sanitation services platform through Banka Bio (execution) and Megaliter (funding and contracting), building and operating treatment plants with long-term service contracts.

call_points.text: FY27 focus on converting contracted revenues into cash through commissioning, billing and collections
₹122 Cr LTV portfolio with 16 contracted projects represents long-term recurring revenue opportunity
Project EBITDA margin at ~60%, focus on making underlying improvement repeatable in FY27
2030 vision targets 15+ billion litres annual water recycling
Management expects continued growth in FY27 with a focus on margin expansion and profitability
12-M order book stands at ₹107 Cr, with a robust pipeline under negotiation
